highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp release will ship compiler XML documentation alongside its managed packages.
highlights_body: API documentation is now maintained with the C# source, while package and binding-generation changes make the consumer-facing documentation more consistent.

bullets.detail: Incorporates the latest upstream Chrome m154 renderer bug fixes into the forthcoming release line.
Managed packages now include compiler XML documentation generated from the C# API comments, improving editor help for package consumers.
Splits generated P/Invoke bindings into per-type files and generates HarfBuzz bindings from the dependency-pinned source for more consistent binding output.
View remarks can now be authored as Markdown for clearer rendered API documentation.
